result.finding: Security is implemented through Azure Managed Identity for passwordless authentication to Azure Service Bus. The Azure Spring Cloud SDK handles TLS encryption in transit automatically. No application-level HTTP security (Spring Security, JWT, OAuth2, CORS, HTTPS termination) is implemented, as the application has no inbound web endpoints.
evidence: application.properties: spring.cloud.azure.credential.managed-identity-enabled=true — uses Azure Managed Identity (no stored secrets/passwords)
application.properties: spring.cloud.azure.credential.client-id= — user-assigned Managed Identity support
spring-cloud-azure-starter provides Azure AD token acquisition via Managed Identity
Azure Service Bus SDK enforces TLS 1.2+ for all AMQP 1.0 connections (transport-level encryption)
No JWT, OAuth2, Basic Auth, or API key implementation in source code
No CORS, HSTS, CSP, or security headers (no HTTP server present)
No encryption code (AES/RSA) found in application source
values: Transport encryption: TLS 1.2+ enforced by Azure Service Bus SDK
No credentials stored in source code or configuration
No HTTP security layer (no inbound web endpoints)
